what_establishes_the_brand_label: The parent directory name under Label_0_Watches or Label_1_Watches. The manifest records no other brand field.
what_establishes_the_authentic_counterfe: The top-level directory. Label_0_Watches is stored as label 0. Label_1_Watches is stored as label 1.
recorded_source_or_independent_verificat: None. The manifest header sets source_status, marketplace_status, and product_id_status to unavailable.
same_source_or_listing: No product id, marketplace, or source URL is stored, so same-listing membership cannot be established from the manifest. Identical SHA-256 copies and identical dHash groups are the only on-disk source-family indicators.
visible_watermarks_are_not_recorded_prov: A watermark seen in an image is an observation. It was not a field in the manifest, and it is not treated as verification of either label.
